title: Three Counters, One Value
goal: buildCounters should return functions producing 0, 10, and 20 — but every function returns 20.
bug_criteria: Must identify variable scope pollution: var is function-scoped, so all three closures capture the SAME binding i, which is 3 after the loop ends. The fix is let (per-iteration block scope) — or capturing the value in an IIFE.
